decisions.reason: Although submarine lighting is farther from the core range and was only mentioned rather than heavily showcased, it is still a multi-model line tied to the firm's maritime customer base, so sunk development effort and the tendency to justify the move support continuation.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's established industrial lighting business, likely required substantial engineering and certification investment, and were publicly presented as a line, which makes management inclined to persist.

The designer task light is less central than the firm's core professional solution business and appears to be a single product, but its close fit with the existing offer and prior public launch still make management more likely to retain it than abandon it quickly.

A pendant office luminaire sits squarely in the firm's workplace lighting direction and energy-efficient LED trajectory, so even if results were mixed management would likely view that as temporary and continue the product.

The premium pendant luminaire is a multi-model line close to the core office and commercial offering, and the visible commitment and invested resources make withdrawal relatively unlikely in the next year.
